title: Protecting Our Planet
text:
Many cities have a big problem with rubbish. Every day, people throw away tons of plastic bags and bottles. Plastic can stay in the environment for hundreds of years. This is bad for animals and for the sea.

Some people are trying to help. In one town, the school teaches children to sort their rubbish into different bins. Many families now bring their own bags to the shop. These small actions make a difference for the planet.

questions.text: How long can plastic stay in the environment?
What does the school in the town teach children?
options: To sort rubbish into different bins

questions.text: Why do many families bring their own bags to the shop?
options: They want to buy more things
They want to help the planet

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Small actions can help protect the environment
Animals do not like the sea

the natural world around us, such as land, air and water
to put things into groups or into different places
the large world on which we live

paragraph_translations: Muitas cidades têm um grande problema com o lixo. Todos os dias, as pessoas jogam fora toneladas de sacolas e garrafas de plástico. O plástico pode permanecer no meio ambiente por centenas de anos. Isso é ruim para os animais e para o mar.

Algumas pessoas estão tentando ajudar. Em uma cidade, a escola ensina as crianças a separar o lixo em lixeiras diferentes. Muitas famílias agora levam suas próprias sacolas para a loja. Essas pequenas ações fazem diferença para o planeta.
